description: This source file provides functions for parsing various types of data (signed, unsigned, int, int64, unsigned long, ssize_t, double), including handling unit suffixes and boolean values. It appears to be part of a larger project related to Git, offering utility functions for parsing values from strings and environment variables.

methods.name: uintmax_t get_unit_factor(const char * end)
methods.description: Converts unit suffixes ('k', 'm', 'g') into their numerical multipliers

methods.name: int git_parse_signed(const char * value,intmax_t * ret,intmax_t max)
methods.description: Parses a signed integer from a string, considering optional unit suffix

methods.name: int git_parse_unsigned(const char * value,uintmax_t * ret,uintmax_t max)
methods.description: Parses an unsigned integer from a string, considering optional unit suffix

methods.name: int git_parse_int(const char * value,int * ret)
methods.description: Parses an int from a string

methods.name: int git_parse_int64(const char * value,int64_t * ret)
methods.description: Parses a 64-bit int from a string

methods.name: int git_parse_ulong(const char * value,unsigned long * ret)
methods.description: Parses an unsigned long from a string

methods.name: int git_parse_ssize_t(const char * value,ssize_t * ret)
methods.description: Parses an ssize_t from a string

methods.name: int git_parse_double(const char * value,double * ret)
methods.description: Parses a double-precision floating point number, with unit suffix support

methods.name: int git_parse_maybe_bool_text(const char * value)
methods.description: Interprets a string as a boolean text ('true', 'false', etc.)

methods.name: int git_parse_maybe_bool(const char * value)
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string as a boolean or integer, returning -1 if indeterminate

methods.name: int git_env_bool(const char * k,int def)
methods.description: Reads an environment variable and interprets it as a boolean value with a default fallback

methods.name: unsigned long git_env_ulong(const char * k,unsigned long val)
methods.description: Reads an environment variable and interprets it as an unsigned long with a default fallback
